description: This PHP source file defines a Security controller class for the admin part of an OpenCart-based web application. It manages security-related functionalities such as checking directory existence, renaming or deleting admin directories, and handling storage directories, with methods to ensure security best practices and facilitate admin operations.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Controller class handling security-related operations for the OpenCart admin panel, including directory checks, renamings, deletions, and permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language data and renders the security view with a list of security status info.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the security list view via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a list of security-related directory statuses, such as existence and rename status, and returns the appropriate view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the security measure to delete the 'install' directory if permissions allow.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Handles moving and verifying storage directories, ensuring security and correct filesystem permissions.

methods.name: storage_delete
methods.description: Deletes the storage directory to improve security.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Renames or modifies the admin directory for security by changing its name and updating relevant configs.

methods.name: admin_delete
methods.description: Deletes the admin directory if necessary.
